description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Izzet Boilerworks.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Locus of Enlightenment
